Your dog knows when you're teasing him.
You see, scientists in Germany passed dogs treats through a gap in a glass wall.
Sometimes they dropped the treat, by accident.
And sometimes they pulled it back, on purpose.
When it was an accident, the dogs just walked around to grab it.
But when they were teased, they waited way longer, and stopped wagging their tails.
So next time you fake a treat, he knows exactly what you're doing.
